name: one-long-word-light-jab
unmodelled: No plug-in. Every node is compiled into this file: duration, strength, curse speed and curse cost change the art record, damage rows are conditional_mods. Variants remove a whole row and recompile

curse_duration_pct rounds to the nearest whole pulse at compile, inside curse_duration_max 5. curse_effect_pct scales raise keys inside Combat's bounds; block_regen is on or off, so strength never touches it
Single Grudge and Set Jaw read 'exactly one curse on the target'. They are written as per enemy_curses, which is the same thing while one art lays one curse

Recast while the curse still stands would count as two records in the calculator. Rule 7 gives statuses a stacking rule and the curse here should refresh. In the main fight the cooldown is 3.486 s and the second firing lands at 6.972 s, 0.028 s before the first curse ends, and no art hit falls in that gap
Enemy sense and fortune: the fixtures have none and nothing here reads them
Status resist and cleanse on the enemy: not run. Curses land at 100 %
